example_note: FICTIONAL example showing the format only. Product, numbers and places are made up; never copy its content into a real plan.
bet: Independent café owners in your city lose hours every week building staff rotas in spreadsheets; showing them Shiftly in person, café by café, gets your first paying clients faster than any online channel.
one_liner: Shiftly helps independent café owners build the staff rota in 10 minutes instead of 2 hours, without spreadsheets or group-chat chaos.

goal.threshold: Walk-in test: at least 1 in 10 visited cafés starts a trial

blockers.blocker: The homepage doesn't say who it's for
blockers.fix: New headline: 'Staff rotas for independent cafés, in 10 minutes'

blockers.blocker: No way to pay after the trial
blockers.fix: Add a payment link to the trial-end email and the account page

channels.name: In-person visits to cafés in your city
channels.why: Owners are reachable at quiet hours; a 2-minute demo on your phone works; you said you're fine talking face to face.

channels.name: Local café owners' association newsletter
channels.why: Reaches many owners at once; a partner route with a member discount.

channels.name: Instagram posts about rota tips
channels.why: Slow to build an audience at 5h/week.

actions.action: Change the homepage headline and add the payment link
actions.output: A visitor understands it and can pay

actions.action: Visit 5 cafés between 2 and 4 pm with the 2-minute demo
Email the association to offer a member discount
Call every trial user on day 3 to help them build their first rota

items.item: Demo account loaded with a sample rota
Printed card with the trial link and a QR code
Log the visit in targets.md the same day

if_then.if: fewer than 1 in 10 visits starts a trial after 15 visits
if_then.then: change the pitch to the no-show feature and test 10 more visits
shift 2h/week from visits to a member webinar

results.note: One owner asked for a printed rota option.
